decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a small, low-cost add-on to the core map.apps platform and still adds value for customers, even though it no longer gets visible promotion.

VueTOC was an experimental mobile layer-control component that has not been visible since 2018, and its function is likely absorbed into the responsive map.apps core, so resources are better used for core development.
Mobile field data capture remains a core need for utility and public-sector customers, even if platform-provider apps put pressure on a proprietary solution.
The search extension is tightly integrated with the established web map apps offer and costs little to maintain, so it is likely retained.
